input_contract.scope:
# Premeasurement contract: permutate

Preserve the original million-sample DVC dataset, size8 source setting, ten blocks ×250 threads, 2500 parallel streams, ceil(10000/2500) batch cap and source early-stop/controller/CPU bzip compression stage. Additional fixed2048-value eight-bit and4096-bit controls exercise both shuffle/statistical entry pairs; not a whole NIST conformance or randomness-certification study.

Known scientific defects remain explicit before measurements: shuffle excludes self-swaps (independent finite combinatorial witness), all batches restart identical tid streams, directional/median longest-run statistics omit the terminal run (executed source CPU witness). Complete four-way numerical agreement will be scoped source-behavior agreement, native_behavior_known_scientific_defect:true, excluded faithful scientific/performance recommendations. No unsupported-framework inference.

The binary CPU compression path has a separately executed ASan one-byte output-string overflow. The owned reference adds exactly one allocation byte. Source GPU bodies remain unchanged. Main/control pipeline is therefore additionally a conditional host-allocation corrected reference; preserve source/diff/witness/hash provenance. Default size8 binary dataset did not overflow its original4*len buffer. Initial ascending witness disproved an inc/dec hypothesis and is archived; corrected descending witness independently demonstrates the actual issue.

Actual native input readbacks contain every input sample, all18 device baseline statistics, all54 initial counters and scalar launch/statistic parameters. Exact byte identity before every model/trial; readonly inputs and explicitly added16-byte guards checked afterward. Own guards are a study intervention, not original source guarantees.

Primary observable artifacts contain the complete original19 baseline statistics, all57 final ranking counters, IID decision, full GPU batch counter history and full CPU compression-statistic/iteration history, with exact actual-input prefix. These are lossless little-endian bytes (dtype uint8), zero tolerances, no canonicalization or value-sampling. All final internal shuffled values are independently checked on every trial against independently generated full CPU permutations and18 statistic values per tid. The binary input allows injective bitpacking of internal shuffle values (nonbinary controls retain complete raw bytes). All final internal shuffled values are retained as complete packed sidecars on measured trial1 per model; other four internal arrays are fully checked but NOT separately archived. Full internal-data archival is distinct from complete primary observable output archival; never imply20 full2.5GB raw internal captures.

Predeclare exact source-statistic/count acceptance and finite outputs. The CPU oracle intentionally represents demonstrated source terminal-run/shuffle behavior; independent mathematical witnesses expose its scientific limitations rather than silently repairing it. Binary lengths divisible8; general input alphabet0..255; original LCG uint64 state mod2^63 but returned uint32 before modulo j.

Timing: original GPU shuffle+18-test launch loops, counts D2H, CPU early-stop, plus common preallocated counter-history copies, with final whole-context completion. Initial CPU baseline/compression, GPU allocation/input copy, exact input readbacks, independent oracle, full internal D2H/sidecar writes and downstream CPU compression are OUTSIDE the source GPU ROI. Full controller executes in every warmup/trial; its total auxiliary wall time is recorded separately. Five checked trials follow one complete compile/warmup; average trials2–5 only. No outlier removal, no implicit full-controller speedup claim from GPU ROI.

Native readiness precedes any target authoring. CPU oracle/canonical generation bounded400MiB/file with2GiB free-space reserve. Each full sidecar312.5MB, four models~1.25GB; central observable artifacts~1MB/trial. Original stale prebuilt binary produced unchecked allzero counts; untrusted. Fresh original sm70 build completed actual ranks and source CPU compression (79 active samples); no false success promoted from the stale executable.
